description: 魔导师的杖，铁木杖身缠着秘银。杖头两侧和上方都有装载槽，放魔晶石，按顺时针一颗一颗读，打出各自的元素伤害。颗与颗之间走单次冷却，一轮读完歇一个总冷却。装着魔晶石时出手不耗耐力。

descriptions.en: A magus's staff: ironwood bound in mithril. Loading slots on either side of its head and one above it take Crystals; it reads them one at a time, clockwise, dealing each one's elemental damage. One single Cooldown between Crystals, one total Cooldown of rest after each full round. While a Crystal is loaded, it costs no Stamina.
